newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Soy shipping conditions at key Brazilian ports.
newsitem.headline: Soy shipping conditions at key Brazilian ports.

text.p: The Brazilian ports of Paranagua and Santos reported the following conditions for shipping soybeans and soy products:

Vessels: Seaboni loading 47,490 tonnes soybeans/meal. Goynuk loading 54,500 tonnes soybeans. Docebrisa loading 55,000 soymeal. Waiting to dock, four vessels to load soybeans, two for soymeal and one for mixed cargo.
Road: 596 trucks carrying soybeans arrived on June 24, as well as 364 trucks with soymeal and 74 trucks with vegetable oils including soyoil.

Vessels: At public terminal, Powhatan loading 57,000 tonnes soymeal. Waiting to dock, two vessels to load soybeans. At Cargill private terminal, no vessels docked. Waiting to dock, one vessel to load soymeal.
Road: 17 trucks carrying 385 tonnes soybeans arrived on June 24 as well as nine trucks with 245 tonnes soymeal.
